title: TraceDance: An Automated System for Building Agent Behavior Benchmarks from Real-World Agent Deployment Traces
abstract: arXiv:2609.33295v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: An agent can complete a task while exhibiting undesirable behavior during execution. Developers need tests for the specific behaviors encountered in deployment, beyond fixed benchmark suites. We present TraceDance, an agent system that constructs targeted benchmarks from deployment traces for user-specified undesirable behaviors. For efficient construction, Anchor-and-Confirm combines programmable retrieval with candidate-level confirmation by a Flash large language model (LLM), while the Anchor Synthesis Loop generates and revises specifications for custom behaviors. The benchmarks use decision-point continuation to evaluate an LLM's next turn at a recorded decision point with a behavior-specific rubric, without a reference answer or environment replay. Experiments in coding and general tool use draw on 252,557 sessions and produce 107 benchmarks with 4,125 instances, fulfilling 95.3% of build-target requests. Both human annotators

translated_title: TraceDance：一个从真实世界智能体部署轨迹中构建智能体行为基准的自动化系统
translated_abstract: 智能体可以在完成任务的同时，在执行过程中表现出不良行为。开发者需要对部署中遇到的特定行为进行测试，而不仅限于固定的基准测试套件。我们提出了TraceDance，这是一个智能体系统，能够从部署轨迹中针对用户指定的不良行为构建定向基准。为了实现高效构建，Anchor-and-Confirm方法将可编程检索与Flash大语言模型（LLM）在候选层面上的确认相结合，同时Anchor Synthesis Loop（锚点合成循环）可以生成并修订自定义行为的规范。这些基准采用决策点续写的方式，在记录的决策点处使用针对特定行为的评分标准来评估LLM的下一轮表现，无需参考答案或环境重放。在编程和通用工具使用方面的实验利用了252,557个会话，产出了107个基准和4,125个实例，满足了95.3%的构建目标请求。人工标注者（摘要至此处截断）
tldr: TraceDance是一个自动化系统，能够从真实世界智能体部署轨迹中针对用户指定的不良行为构建定向基准，并通过无需参考答案或环境重放的决策点续写方法评估智能体行为，最终产出107个基准共4,125个实例。
en_tdlr: TraceDance is an automated system that builds targeted behavior benchmarks from real-world agent deployment traces for user-specified undesirable behaviors, evaluating agents via decision-point continuation without reference answers or environment replay, producing 107 benchmarks with 4,125 instances.
